answer: Each identity must solve a Wesolowski VDF by repeatedly squaring a fixed input modulo a modulus, with every step depending on the previous one. GPUs cannot divide a single chain’s sequential work among devices; clones need separate chains, each requiring elapsed computation. A public beacon fixes the challenge, while the glacier epoch and horizon deadline define the proof window. This creates a physical time bottleneck, though it does not prevent parallel hardware from running multiple chains.
